summary: EShallGo Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer trading in the US, filed a 6-K furnishing proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 9-10, 2026 (Shanghai time). Shareholders will vote on a five-for-one share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares from US$0.0016 to US$0.008 par, a conforming fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles, and a continuation/redomestication from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands. The board urges approval of each proposal. No price, premium, stake, or transaction consideration is stated. What to watch: whether the consolidation satisfies Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance and whether the BVI continuation alters shareholder rights.
